title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Account-Holder Bonus on Special Order Damage Allowances
content:
Holders of a Ridgeline Pro Credit account receive a credit-account bonus on the damage allowance of a Ridgeline Special Order Services order in a program paid in full at order.

**Clause.** The credit-account bonus depends on the customer's Ridgeline Pro Credit account: an active account opened at least 60 whole months before today gives a credit-account bonus of 1; an active account opened fewer than 60 whole months before today gives 0.5; otherwise the credit-account bonus is 0.

The credit-account bonus is a number of percentage points added to the percentage of the delivered price at which the damage allowance is figured.

## Records read

The customer's Ridgeline Pro Credit account record: its status and the date it was opened.

## Bonus by account record

| Pro Credit account status | Whole months from opening to today | Bonus (points) |
|---|---|---|
| active | 60 or more | 1 |
| active | fewer than 60 | 0.5 |
| applied, on hold, closed, declined or charged off | any | 0 |
| no Pro Credit account | — | 0 |

## Boundary dates (hypothetical today of 8 October 2026, active account)

| Opened | Whole months to today | Bonus |
|---|---|---|
| 8 October 2021 | 60 | 1 |
| 9 October 2021 | 59 | 0.5 |
| 3 March 2025 | 19 | 0.5 |
